name: Metorase ~Dokilove ☆ Shinkon Iinkai~
original_name: メトラセ～ドキらぶ☆新婚委員会～
source:
Haruto is just perfect. He is good at sports, smart, good-looking, gentle, and from a rich family. Every female student loves him, but he can never trust others. That is his one and only weakness. One day, a competition is held at school. That is to decide Haruto's bride and five girls go to the final, Kanae, Yumiwa, Yuino, Mimi, and Aika. They all love him from the bottom of heart. Their final battle now starts....
